    An upper bound for Ext¹(S_v, M) #

    The mirror of finrank_ext1_simple_le: a normalized derivation B → Hom_k(S_v, M) is determined by the vectors χ_b = δ(α_b)(s₀) for the arrows b starting at v; each χ_b lies in e_{tgt b} M and is killed by every forbidden successor of b. Inner derivations of vectors u ∈ e_v M give (α_b u)_b. Hence dim Ext¹(S_v, M) + dim E₀' ≤ Σ_b dim Y_b + dim K₀' (finrank_ext1_simple_left_le), where E₀' = e_v M, K₀' ⊆ E₀' is killed by the arrows out of v, and Y_b is the space above.
